title: q5 cut-gauge Delsarte barrier, theta isoperimetry, explicit U81 transport, Jennings memory, and three outside-box probes
purpose: Execute five active fronts after collision-reconciling Pass5110-5117 plus three outside-box probes.
headline_results: q5 counterexamples now require minimum chamber leader >=17; every codeword support is 4(q-1)-regular inside the degree-8(q-1) theta graph; explicit polynomial H27-state/F3^3-program transport in U81; explicit q3 Z/3 saturation generator; safe-characteristic rank-two Jennings root-height memory; q7 native-rank drop is 10 and kills the naive cubic extrapolation; q3/q5/q7 bicycle dimensions 29/129/349; Tor coker(H^T) is equivariantly isomorphic to Z(U81) as an F3[U81 semidirect V4]-module.
boundary: The q5/all-q minimum-distance theorem remains open. The odd-q bicycle formula q^3+q-1 has three exact anchors but remains conjectural. Finite arithmetic/group modules are not assigned particle, charge, or hardware interpretations.
